Mathematical Definition: Count of detected re-entry events for each song.
Interpretation: Measures how frequently a song returns to the chart.
Limitations: Depends on chart coverage and re-entry detection.

Mathematical Definition: Previous Chart Position - Re-entry Chart Position.
Interpretation: Positive values indicate improvement in chart position.
Limitations: Does not establish the reason for rank movement.

Interpretation: Positive values indicate an increase in Spotify popularity.
Limitations: Spotify popularity is not a direct stream count.

Mathematical Definition: Mean of normalized positive rank improvement and normalized positive popularity change.
Interpretation: Higher scores indicate stronger combined positive rank and popularity changes.
Limitations: Depends on min-max normalization and selected components.

Mathematical Definition: Maximum of positive popularity change divided by maximum of elapsed calendar days and 1.
Interpretation: Measures positive popularity change relative to the elapsed time between chart appearances.
Limitations: Does not directly measure listener activity or engagement.

Mathematical Definition: Rank improvement from re-entry position to peak position divided by recovery days, subject to the zero-day handling rule.
Interpretation: Measures chart-position improvement per calendar day.
Limitations: Can be undefined when positive improvement occurs on the re-entry date itself.

Mathematical Definition: Calendar days between re-entry date and last observed chart appearance in the comeback run.
Interpretation: Measures observed chart retention after comeback.
Limitations: May be right-censored at the end of the dataset.

Mathematical Definition: Mean of available normalized re-entry frequency, average popularity spike sharpness and average rank recovery speed.
Interpretation: Provides a composite chart-based indicator of repeated activity and comeback-related performance.
Limitations: Not a direct measurement of audience loyalty, fan behaviour or actual fandom size.
